items.title: 63519_Wild Bill Davison oral history interview
items.q: Demsey used to come in and that's the kind of people who hung around in there.

ctx.x: And, he married the boss--- Johnny Fogarty--- and moved to California; I don't know whether they're still alive--- but, anyway, and then we had the
William Sisters -- and Demsey--used to come in -- I think he married one of the William Sisters---
